title: UGANDA FOR ITU COUNCIL OF ADMINISTRATION (2027–2030)
text:
UGANDA
FOR ITU COUNCIL (2027–2030)

Who We Are
Uganda stands at the heart of Africa’s digital renaissance, a nation committed
to harnessing technology to transform lives, bridge divides, and foster global
cooperation.
As an active member of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) since
1963, Uganda has collaborated closely with the Union to expand broadband
access, enhance cybersecurity, promote digital inclusion, and develop resilient ICT
ecosystems.
Uganda is implementing Digital transformation initiatives, including deploying
broadband in remote schools and health centres, bridging the digital divide,
providing assistive technologies for persons with disabilities, and supporting youth
and entrepreneurs through Public Access Centres.
Our story highlights innovation, resilience, and collaboration, demonstrating that
with the right partnerships, digital transformation can extend to every village, school,
and citizen.
A connected, inclusive, and sustainable digital future, for
Our Africa and the world.

Our Campaign Pillars
1. Universal Connectivity — Championing affordable, secure, and inclusive access
for all.
2. Digital Innovation — Driving adoption of emerging technologies to accelerate
sustainable growth.
3. Cyber Resilience — Building trust in digital ecosystems through capacity and
collaboration.
4. Youth and Gender Empowerment — Expanding digital opportunities for women
and young innovators.
5. Regional and Global Solidarity — Deepening cooperation to achieve the WSIS and
SDG goals.
Our Promise
If elected, Uganda will maintain its role as a unifying, forward-looking voice on
the ITU Council, supporting fairness, inclusivity, and technological progress for
all countries.
We will work tirelessly to:
• Strengthen multilateral partnerships and consensus-driven
decision-making.
• Support innovation and resilience in developing countries.
• Ensure that no one is left behind in the global digital
transformation.
